title: TAKETHIS accepted in IHAVE mode (RFC 4644 mode violation)
description: transit/peering/session.rs:111-143: TAKETHIS does not call check_mode_guard(). RFC 4644 specifies TAKETHIS is streaming-mode only. In IHAVE mode, a peer sending TAKETHIS should receive 401 but instead receives 239 (success). CHECK correctly calls check_mode_guard() at line 100. Fix: add check_mode_guard() call at the start of the TAKETHIS handler.
